title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence
provider: European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA)

eligibility_rules.evidence_quote: Applicants must hold a Bachelor of Science (or equivalent, min 180 ECTS) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
Demonstrated academic excellence corresponding to an above-average GPA (minimum 3.2 on a 4.0 scale or top 20% of graduating class).
Command of English is mandatory: C1 level, IELTS Academic minimum overall 6.5 with no band lower than 6.0, or TOEFL iBT minimum 90.
Erasmus Mundus scholarships are awarded to students from partner countries worldwide under geographic quota windows.

document_requirements.instructions: Detailed Europass CV detailing engineering projects, publications, and open-source contributions.
Statement of purpose (max 1000 words) addressing your research objectives across the 3 European consortium universities.
Official transcripts of academic records in original language accompanied by a certified English translation.
Two academic recommendation letters on official university letterhead signed by professors who taught the applicant.
B.Sc. Degree certificate or provisional completion letter from university registrar.
Valid IELTS Academic or TOEFL test report form.
